title: Wreck and Current
author: Cyrus Reyes
blurb: Dominic Zhou, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must cross the range ahead of the snows before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
